traps.shape: The organization-folder descriptor's endpoint form fill builds the registered-server list without checking the caller, and a descriptor fill can be addressed directly by any caller who can read the server.
traps.realistic_because: the reported route: real, unmodified upstream code whose fill performs no permission check

traps.shape: The credential descriptor's fill delegates to the shared list builder without an item context, so the context-dependent decision cannot run for that descriptor.
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: a one-line delegate reached through a static import, one file away from the landing point

traps.shape: The same list is offered inside items as an ordinary form fill; an unconditional administrator check or a POST-only rule closes the disclosure but hides the choices from the user who configures the item and stops the picker from loading.
traps.realistic_because: the package already carries an unconditional administrator check on the adjacent test-connection action and POST-only validation methods, so one of those idioms is the natural thing to copy

traps.shape: The branch-source descriptor carries its own copy of the same endpoint loop instead of the shared builder, so a guard applied to the shared builder leaves this fill unchanged.
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: a second inline implementation of the same list in the sibling descriptor one file away

traps.shape: A checkout-trait descriptor offers the same registered-server list through its own fill with no authority check, beside a credentials fill that already applies the context-dependent rule.
traps.realistic_because: injected sibling: a maintainer-added form fill next to the trait's existing, correctly guarded credentials fill, reached through the real descriptor form-fill entry point

traps.shape: The global configuration descriptor offers the same list through its own fill; the configuration page's administrator requirement does not cover the individually addressable fill.
traps.realistic_because: injected sibling: a maintainer-added form fill on the global configuration descriptor whose page-level permission does not reach the fill URL, reached through the real descriptor form-fill entry point

a.summary: guards the registered-endpoint choice list by the caller's context
